scope.entries: verified Pod IPv4 /32 plus concrete host veth; both source+iif and destination+oif required

mechanism.runtime_membership: remove obsolete entries, verify, add validated entries, verify

eligibility: IPv4 allocated within confirmed CP1-owned block
concrete cali veth and peer identity verified
membership.new_pending_pods_without_ip: not eligible; do not invalidate already verified members
membership.ipam_block_ownership_change: withdraw; never silently broaden to another block
membership.unknown_or_reused_identity: remove old grant before considering a new identity

proposed_lifetime.renewal: explicit bounded operator decision; no automatic extension

terminal_conditions: original Runtime six rules and full expected firewall restored
recovery.unrelated_drift: do not overwrite or reload foreign changes; withdraw known owned grant where provable and retain review-required state
recovery.connection_tracking: no host-wide flush; existing established flows may outlive rule withdrawal

handoff.during_member_update: wait until reconciliation completes; recheck latest generation before and after target action
handoff.legacy_consumer_behavior: continues rejecting new CNI state until a reviewed consumer is implemented
handoff.protection_transition: 6/6 Ready plus separately approved HEP/GNP cutover; readiness alone never disarms recovery
